title: Paired Unequal Winged Samara
description: One original whole stylised paired winged tree fruit. Two unequal complete seed-and-wing bodies join at their narrow basal end and diverge in a V: each plump rounded nucleus continuously narrows into a long finite thin blade that broadens distally and tapers again to a small tip. Kernel and wing share every connecting section within one closed mesh; no separate leaf, old bean, aircraft part or texture card is attached. Both genuine thick nuclei have small ground soles, while the blades gently lift and fold. Three opaque matte dry-plant PBR roles with no textures. Two meshes form one prop, zero scenes or extra seed/wing assets. Metres, Z up, actual horizontal bounds-centred. Static stylised samara-like appearance only, no exact tree species, botanical identification, flight/aerodynamics, seed dispersal, growth, germination, ecology or real-world use claim.
